title: KP app — backend / frontend handshake
auth: Authorization: Bearer <shared token>. /api/session and /api/review require it. /api/comms GET is public; POST requires it.

ownership.frontend: everything visual — layout, colours, fonts, card design, buttons, animations, screen flow
ownership.backend: where cards come from + what to show next + what counts as learned (deck, scheduling, Leitner, streak)

session.purpose: the cards to show now + live stats; call ONCE at session start and walk the list locally

back.kernfakt: string (may be empty -> skip the row)

cards.topic: string — answer title for the back

session.notes: cards already ordered (due-first, then new) and already exclude today's done. Empty cards = nothing due now -> show your done/empty state.

review.notes: server does the box / schedule / streak math; just render the returned stats.

skip.notes: Spaeter = no backend call. Reorder the held list locally; the card stays eligible next /api/session because it was never marked done-today.

stats.notes: no separate call — every /api/session and every /api/review returns the stats block.

comms.purpose: this shared channel. GET returns { contract, log }. POST { from, msg } appends a note.

rules: Fetch /api/session once per session; do NOT re-fetch mid-session (it re-shuffles).
Always send the user's LOCAL date as today (UTC fallback is off by hours at midnight).
Put all four calls behind ONE 'talks to backend' module in the frontend source so the seam stays clean across re-exports.

status.backend: endpoints code-complete + pushed; go live on next worker deploy

backendMessage: Frontend: read the contract above and build your 'talks to backend' module against /api/session + /api/review. Reply on this channel — POST /api/comms { from: 'frontend', msg } or use the post box on the board page — and I'll read it here. This channel survives your export because it's a URL, not shipped code. — backend
